"""Scoped follow-up verification runner; never stages or refreshes historical evidence."""
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from hashlib import sha256
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import time

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
E = ROOT / 'docs/acceptance/MS7-MIG-V02/i02-handoff-followup-20261015'
HEAD = '76d8eac6387a5fde5432a0e8130a881cb6d7ba82'
ALLOWED = {'backend/content/releases.py', 'backend/infrastructure/http/app.py',
           'backend/tests/v02/test_unit.py', 'backend/tests/v02/test_http.py',
           'backend/infrastructure/http/README.md'}
ENV = {**os.environ, 'GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS': '0', 'PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE': '1', 'PYTHONIOENCODING': 'utf-8',
       'DJANGO_SECRET_KEY': 'synthetic-i02-followup-only', 'DJANGO_DB_BACKEND': 'sqlite',
       'DJANGO_RUNTIME_ROOT': str(ROOT / 'var/i02-handoff-contract-runtime')}
PY = str(ROOT / 'var/ms7-mig-v02-venv/Scripts/python.exe')

def digest(raw):
    return sha256(raw).hexdigest()

def git(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git', *args], cwd=ROOT, env=ENV)

def save(path, value):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')

def run(label, argv, extra=None, timeout=900):
    started = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    tick = time.monotonic()
    try:
        result = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=ROOT, env={**ENV, **(extra or {})}, capture_output=True, timeout=timeout)
        code, stdout, stderr = result.returncode, result.stdout, result.stderr
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as error:
        code, stdout, stderr = 124, error.stdout or b'', (error.stderr or b'') + b'\nVerification runner timeout\n'
    E.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (E / (label + '.stdout.log')).write_bytes(stdout)
    (E / (label + '.stderr.log')).write_bytes(stderr)
    text = (stdout + b'\n' + stderr).decode('utf-8', errors='replace')
    counts = re.findall(r'Ran (\d+) tests? in', text)
    named = [{'name': match[1], 'result': match[2]} for match in re.findall(
        r'^(test_\w+) \(([\w.]+)\) \.\.\. (ok|FAIL|ERROR|skipped[^\r\n]*)', text, re.MULTILINE)]
    record = {'label': label, 'started_utc': started, 'elapsed_seconds': round(time.monotonic() - tick, 3),
              'argv': argv, 'exit_code': code, 'stdout_sha256': digest(stdout), 'stderr_sha256': digest(stderr),
              'test_count': int(counts[-1]) if counts else None, 'named_tests': named,
              'tested_implementation_sha': None, 'parent_candidate_sha': HEAD,
              'result': 'PASS' if code == 0 else 'FAIL'}
    save(E / (label + '.json'), record)
    print(json.dumps({k: v for k, v in record.items() if k != 'named_tests'}), flush=True)
    if code:
        print(text[-6000:], flush=True)
    return code

def initial():
    assert git('rev-parse', 'HEAD').decode().strip() == HEAD
    assert git('branch', '--show-current').decode().strip() == 'ms7-mig-v02-content'
    assert not git('diff', '--cached', '--name-only')
    protected = {}
    for raw in git('ls-files', '-z').split(b'\0'):
        if raw:
            p = raw.decode()
            if p not in ALLOWED:
                protected[p] = digest((ROOT / p).read_bytes())
    idx = Path(git('rev-parse', '--git-path', 'index').decode().strip())
    baseline = {p: {'blob_oid': git('rev-parse', HEAD + ':' + p).decode().strip(),
                    'blob_sha256': digest(git('show', HEAD + ':' + p))} for p in sorted(ALLOWED)}
    save(E / 'source-baseline.json', {'initial_head': HEAD,
        'initial_tree_oid': git('rev-parse', 'HEAD^{tree}').decode().strip(),
        'initial_branch': 'ms7-mig-v02-content', 'initial_status': 'Clean working tree/index verified before edits',
        'raw_index_sha256': digest(idx.read_bytes()), 'protected_working_hashes': protected, 'allowed_baseline': baseline,
        'authority': 'User supplied Implement Approved I02 Consumer Handoff Fixes, relaying Ruslan/Ilya agreement; no commit/push approval'})
    print(json.dumps({'protected_files': len(protected), 'baseline_head': HEAD}))

if __name__ == '__main__':
    mode = sys.argv[1]
    if mode == 'initial':
        initial()
    elif mode == 'red':
        sys.exit(run('before-fix-home', [PY, '-B', '-m', 'unittest',
            'backend.tests.v02.test_unit.I02HandoffUnitTests.test_home_requires_slug_alias_even_with_valid_manifest_digest',
            'backend.tests.v02.test_http.SQLiteHTTPTests.test_i02_home_missing_alias_fails_closed_without_renderer_or_redirect', '-v']))
    elif mode == 'unit-http':
        sys.exit(run('v02-unit-http', [PY, '-B', '-m', 'unittest',
            'backend.tests.v02.test_unit', 'backend.tests.v02.test_http', '-v']))
    elif mode == 'v02-pg':
        sys.exit(run('v02-complete', [PY, '-B', '-m', 'unittest', 'backend.tests.v02.test_unit',
            'backend.tests.v02.test_http', 'backend.tests.v02.test_postgres', 'backend.tests.v02.test_asset_regressions', '-v'],
            {'MATHSTART_V02_TEST_ADMIN_URL': 'postgresql+psycopg://postgres:synthetic-local-only@127.0.0.1:15441/postgres'}))
    elif mode == 'r02':
        sys.exit(run('r02-contracts', [PY, '-B', '-m', 'unittest', 'discover', '-s', 'tests', '-p', 'test_migration_r02_*.py', '-v']))
    elif mode == 'baseline':
        sys.exit(run('baseline-driver', [PY, '-B', '-m', 'backend.tests.v02.baseline'],
            {'MATHSTART_V02_TEST_ADMIN_URL': 'postgresql+psycopg://postgres:synthetic-local-only@127.0.0.1:15441/postgres'}))
    elif mode == 'command':
        sys.exit(run(sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3:]))

"""Recheck the new loader against the new disposable 279/263 source baseline."""
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import uuid
from hashlib import sha256

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))

ROOT = Path.cwd()
E = ROOT / 'docs/acceptance/MS7-MIG-V02/i02-handoff-followup-20261015'
driver = [json.loads(line) for line in (E / 'baseline-driver.stdout.log').read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines() if line.startswith('{')]
runtime = Path(driver[0]['log']).parent
record = json.loads((runtime / 'results.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert record['disposable'] and record['database'].startswith('ms6_v01_smoke_v02_')
assert all(r['exit_code'] == 0 for r in record['commands'])
os.environ.update(DJANGO_DB_BACKEND='postgresql', DJANGO_DB_HOST='127.0.0.1', DJANGO_DB_PORT='15441',
    DJANGO_DB_NAME=record['database'], DJANGO_DB_USER='postgres', DJANGO_DB_PASSWORD='synthetic-local-only',
    DJANGO_SECRET_KEY='synthetic-i02-followup-baseline', DJANGO_DEBUG='0', DJANGO_RUNTIME_ROOT=str(runtime))
original = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-B', '-m', 'backend.tests.v02.public_baseline_projection'], capture_output=True)
assert original.returncode == 0, original.stderr.decode(errors='replace')[-2000:]
print(original.stdout.decode(), flush=True)
import sqlalchemy as sa
from sqlalchemy.engine import URL
from backend.content.projection import ReviewedSource, delivery_candidate, build_index_candidate
from backend.content.releases import Descriptor, ReleaseStore
from backend.infrastructure.database import DatabaseConfig, create_engine
from backend.infrastructure.uow import UnitOfWork
from backend.models.baseline import ContentPage, LessonPublication
engine = create_engine(DatabaseConfig(URL.create('postgresql+psycopg', username='postgres',
    password='synthetic-local-only', host='127.0.0.1', port=15441, database=record['database'])))
release_id = 'i02-loader-' + uuid.uuid4().hex
root = ROOT / 'var' / release_id
pages_root = root / release_id / 'pages'
pages_root.mkdir(parents=True)
sql = []
sa.event.listen(engine, 'before_cursor_execute', lambda c, cu, statement, p, ctx, m: sql.append(statement))
with UnitOfWork(engine) as uow:
    uow.session.execute(sa.text('SET TRANSACTION READ ONLY'))
    pages = list(uow.session.scalars(sa.select(ContentPage).where(ContentPage.is_published.is_(True)).order_by(ContentPage.id)))
    deliveries = {}
    for page in pages:
        source = uow.session.scalar(sa.select(LessonPublication.source_path).where(LessonPublication.page_id == page.id))
        source = 'curriculum/' + source if source else f'site_content/pages/{page.slug}/page.json'
        path = (ROOT / source).resolve()
        assert path.is_relative_to(ROOT)
        if path.is_dir():
            source += '/lesson.json'
            path /= 'lesson.json'
        data = delivery_candidate(uow, page.slug, ReviewedSource(source, sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), ()))
        deliveries[page.id] = data
        (pages_root / f'{page.id}.json').write_text(json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False), encoding='utf-8')
    index = build_index_candidate(uow, release_id, deliveries)
raw = json.dumps(index, ensure_ascii=False).encode('utf-8')
(root / release_id / 'index.json').write_bytes(raw)
descriptor = Descriptor(uuid.uuid4(), release_id, sha256(raw).hexdigest(), 1)
release = ReleaseStore(root).load(descriptor)
assert len(release.pages) == 279 and len(release.index['catalogue']['topics']) == 263
context = release.renderer_context(release.page('karta-sajta'), {'q': 'НЕСУЩЕСТВУЮЩАЯ ТЕМА'})
assert context['catalogue_full'] == index['catalogue']
assert context['pinned_release'] == {'release_id': release_id, 'manifest_digest': descriptor.manifest_digest}
assert context['catalogue_count'] == 0
assert all(q.lstrip().upper().startswith(('SELECT', 'SET TRANSACTION READ ONLY')) for q in sql)
print(json.dumps({'full_profile_loader': 'PASS', 'pages': 279, 'topics': 263,
    'home_alias': release.page_path('/glavnaya/')['seo']['canonical_path'],
    'catalogue_full_and_identity': 'PASS', 'empty_search_count': 0, 'read_only_sql': 'PASS',
    'assets_scope': 'Metadata/loader profile uses empty reviewed asset arrays; full asset regressions are in V02 suite',
    'activation': 'NOT_PERFORMED', 'i02_html_no_js': 'NOT_VERIFIED'}))
engine.dispose()

"""Actual localhost HTTP smoke with no installed/imported Django and a new marked DB."""
import importlib.util
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import socket
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import urllib.error
import urllib.request
import uuid

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))

if '--serve' in sys.argv:
    from backend.infrastructure.http.runtime import application
    import uvicorn
    uvicorn.run(application(), host='127.0.0.1', port=int(sys.argv[-1]), access_log=False, log_level='warning')
    raise SystemExit(0)

assert importlib.util.find_spec('django') is None
import sqlalchemy as sa
from sqlalchemy.engine import make_url
from backend.content.releases import ReleaseStore
from backend.infrastructure.database import DatabaseConfig, create_engine
from backend.infrastructure.http.runtime import application
from backend.migrations.upgrade import fresh
from backend.tests.v02.fixtures import seed, release_files, activate_fixture
root = Path('var/i02-runtime-' + uuid.uuid4().hex).resolve()
root.mkdir(parents=True)
url = make_url('postgresql+psycopg://postgres:synthetic-local-only@127.0.0.1:15441/postgres')
name = 'test_ms7_mig_v01_v02_runtime_' + uuid.uuid4().hex
admin = sa.create_engine(url, isolation_level='AUTOCOMMIT', hide_parameters=True)
quoted = admin.dialect.identifier_preparer.quote(name)
with admin.connect() as connection:
    connection.execute(sa.text('CREATE DATABASE ' + quoted))
    connection.execute(sa.text("COMMENT ON DATABASE " + quoted + " IS 'MS7-MIG-V01 disposable synthetic test database'"))
engine = create_engine(DatabaseConfig(url.set(database=name)))
with engine.begin() as connection:
    fresh(connection)
seed(engine)
store, descriptor, index, deliveries = release_files(root)
activate_fixture(engine, descriptor)
context = store.load(descriptor).renderer_context(deliveries[304], {'q': 'none'})
assert context['catalogue_full'] == index['catalogue'] and context['catalogue_count'] == 0
environment = {**os.environ, 'MATHSTART_DATABASE_URL': str(url.set(database=name).render_as_string(hide_password=False)),
    'MATHSTART_HTTP_SIGNING_KEY': 'synthetic-i02-runtime-only', 'MATHSTART_PUBLIC_ORIGIN': 'https://mathstart.example',
    'MATHSTART_RELEASE_ROOT': str(root), 'PYTHONIOENCODING': 'utf-8', 'PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE': '1'}
with socket.socket() as sock:
    sock.bind(('127.0.0.1', 0))
    port = sock.getsockname()[1]
log = root / 'server.log'
cases = []
with log.open('wb') as output:
    server = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, '-B', __file__, '--serve', str(port)], env=environment,
                              stdout=output, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    try:
        for _ in range(100):
            if server.poll() is not None:
                raise RuntimeError('Smoke server exited before startup')
            try:
                with socket.create_connection(('127.0.0.1', port), timeout=0.1):
                    break
            except OSError:
                time.sleep(0.1)
        else:
            raise RuntimeError('Smoke server startup timeout')
        for path, status in [('/api/v1/grades/', 200), ('/api/v1/content/pages/topic/', 200),
                             ('/_content/index.json', 200), ('/static/theme.css', 200),
                             ('/api/v1/staff/pages/', 401), ('/api/v1/nope/', 404),
                             ('/', 503), ('/karta-sajta/?q=none', 503)]:
            try:
                response = urllib.request.urlopen(f'http://127.0.0.1:{port}' + path, timeout=10)
            except urllib.error.HTTPError as error:
                response = error
            with response:
                raw = response.read()
                assert response.status == status, (path, response.status)
                if path == '/_content/index.json':
                    assert json.loads(raw) == index
                if path == '/api/v1/content/pages/topic/':
                    assert json.loads(raw)['data'] == deliveries[302]
                cases.append({'path': path, 'status': response.status})
    finally:
        server.terminate()
        try:
            server.wait(timeout=10)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            server.kill()
            server.wait(timeout=5)
assert not any(k == 'django' or k.startswith('django.') for k in sys.modules)
engine.dispose()
admin.dispose()
print(json.dumps({'django_installed': False, 'django_imported': False, 'runtime_context_provider': 'PASS',
    'http_smoke': cases, 'html_renderer': 'ABSENT_AS_DESIGNED: public HTML 503',
    'database': name, 'disposable': True, 'retained_runtime': str(root),
    'public_contract_unchanged': True, 'i02_html_no_js': 'NOT_VERIFIED'}))

"""Retain new follow-up receipts without rewriting any candidate manifest/pin."""
import ast
import base64
from collections import Counter
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from hashlib import sha256
import importlib.metadata
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess
import sys

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / 'var'))
import i02_handoff_verify as v
E = v.E
INITIAL = json.loads((E / 'source-baseline.json').read_bytes())
assert not (E / 'verification.json').exists(), 'Final evidence already exists: refuse overwrite'

def sha(raw):
    return sha256(raw).hexdigest()

def save(path, data):
    v.save(path, data)

def git(*argv, data=None):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git', *argv], cwd=ROOT, env=v.ENV, input=data)

assert git('rev-parse', 'HEAD').decode().strip() == v.HEAD
assert git('branch', '--show-current').decode().strip() == 'ms7-mig-v02-content'
assert git('rev-parse', 'HEAD^{tree}').decode().strip() == INITIAL['initial_tree_oid']
index_path = Path(git('rev-parse', '--git-path', 'index').decode().strip())
assert sha(index_path.read_bytes()) == INITIAL['raw_index_sha256']
assert not git('diff', '--cached', '--name-only')
changed = set(git('diff', '--name-only').decode().splitlines())
assert changed == v.ALLOWED, changed
for path, pin in INITIAL['protected_working_hashes'].items():
    assert sha((ROOT / path).read_bytes()) == pin, 'Protected source drift: ' + path
new_paths = git('ls-files', '--others', '--exclude-standard').decode().splitlines()
assert all(p.startswith(E.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix() + '/') for p in new_paths), new_paths

raw_receipts = {}
commands = []
for receipt_path in sorted(E.glob('*.json')):
    record = json.loads(receipt_path.read_bytes())
    if 'label' not in record:
        continue
    label = receipt_path.stem
    if label == 'before-fix-home':
        assert record['exit_code'] == 1 and record['test_count'] == 2
        record['classification'] = 'EXPECTED_FAIL: old production loader; seven assertion/subtest failures across two regressions'
    elif label == 'runtime-no-django-initial-harness-error':
        assert record['exit_code'] == 1
        record['classification'] = 'RESOLVED verification helper import path, before runtime startup; not a product failure'
    elif label == 'runtime-environment-pip':
        assert record['exit_code'] == 1
        record['classification'] = 'Runtime venv intentionally has no pip module; dependency check subsequently PASS using pip --python'
    else:
        assert record['exit_code'] == 0, record
        record['classification'] = 'PASS'
    stdout = (E / (label + '.stdout.log')).read_bytes()
    stderr = (E / (label + '.stderr.log')).read_bytes()
    assert sha(stdout) == record['stdout_sha256'] and sha(stderr) == record['stderr_sha256']
    raw_receipts[label] = {'stdout_base64': base64.b64encode(stdout).decode(),
                           'stderr_base64': base64.b64encode(stderr).decode(),
                           'stdout_sha256': sha(stdout), 'stderr_sha256': sha(stderr)}
    record['raw_receipt_key'] = label
    commands.append(record)
    save(receipt_path, record)

driver = [json.loads(line) for line in base64.b64decode(raw_receipts['baseline-driver']['stdout_base64']).decode().splitlines() if line.startswith('{')]
baseline_root = Path(driver[0]['log']).parent
baseline_record = json.loads((baseline_root / 'results.json').read_bytes())
assert baseline_record['disposable'] and len(baseline_record['commands']) == 5
for label, record in zip(['fresh-install-smoke', 'verify-repo', 'baseline-version-report', 'r02a', 'r03a'], baseline_record['commands']):
    raw = Path(record['log']).read_bytes()
    assert record['exit_code'] == 0
    text = raw.decode('utf-8', errors='replace')
    counts = [int(x) for x in re.findall(r'Ran (\d+) tests? in', text)]
    if label == 'verify-repo':
        assert 'RESULT: PASS (8 checks passed).' in text
    if label == 'r02a':
        assert counts == [30]
    if label == 'r03a':
        assert counts == [41]
    raw_receipts[label] = {'combined_base64': base64.b64encode(raw).decode(), 'combined_sha256': sha(raw)}
    named = [{'name': m[1], 'result': m[2]} for m in re.findall(
        r'^(test_\w+) \(([\w.]+)\)(?:(?!^test_).)*?\.\.\. (ok|FAIL|ERROR|skipped[^\r\n]*)',
        text, re.MULTILINE | re.DOTALL)]
    commands.append({'label': label, 'argv': record['argv'], 'exit_code': 0, 'classification': 'PASS',
        'suite_test_counts': counts, 'named_tests': named, 'source_log': record['log'],
        'combined_sha256': sha(raw), 'raw_receipt_key': label})

matrix = []
for record in commands:
    if record['label'] in {'v02-complete', 'v01-complete', 'r02-contracts', 'r02a', 'r03a'}:
        for test in record.get('named_tests', []):
            assert test['result'] == 'ok', test
            matrix.append({'suite': record['label'], **test})
counts = Counter(item['suite'] for item in matrix)
assert counts == {'v02-complete': 108, 'v01-complete': 34, 'r02-contracts': 63, 'r02a': 30, 'r03a': 41}, counts
new_method_names = set()
for path in ['backend/tests/v02/test_unit.py', 'backend/tests/v02/test_http.py']:
    def methods(raw):
        tree = ast.parse(raw)
        return {item.name for node in tree.body if isinstance(node, ast.ClassDef)
                for item in node.body if isinstance(item, ast.FunctionDef) and item.name.startswith('test_')}
    new_method_names |= methods((ROOT / path).read_bytes()) - methods(git('show', v.HEAD + ':' + path))
new_executions = [r for r in matrix if r['suite'] == 'v02-complete' and r['name'].split('.')[-1] in new_method_names]
assert len(new_method_names) == 15 and len(new_executions) == 22
save(E / 'test-inventory.json', {'counts': counts, 'new_test_methods': sorted(new_method_names),
    'new_test_executions': new_executions, 'all_named_contract_and_target_tests': matrix,
    'v02_postgresql_tests': sum('PostgreSQL' in r['name'] for r in matrix if r['suite'] == 'v02-complete'),
    'skips_in_named_suites': 0, 'verify_repo_nested_counts': [109, 18, 73], 'verify_repo_checks': 8})

diff = git('diff', '--binary', '--no-ext-diff', '--', *sorted(v.ALLOWED))
save(E / 'source-diff.json', {'parent_candidate_sha': v.HEAD, 'git_diff_sha256': sha(diff),
    'git_diff_base64': base64.b64encode(diff).decode(), 'numstat': git('diff', '--numstat').decode(),
    'encoding': 'Base64 preserves exact patch bytes; it is not a historical patch rewrite'})
files = {}
for path in sorted(v.ALLOWED):
    raw = (ROOT / path).read_bytes()
    canonical = raw.replace(b'\r\n', b'\n')
    oid = git('hash-object', '--path=' + path, '--stdin', data=raw).decode().strip()
    attr = git('check-attr', '-a', '--', path).decode().splitlines()
    files[path] = {**INITIAL['allowed_baseline'][path], 'working_sha256': sha(raw), 'working_bytes': len(raw),
                  'reviewed_blob_sha256': sha(canonical), 'prospective_blob_oid': oid,
                  'effective_attributes_all': attr, 'mode': '100644', 'staged': False}
save(E / 'changed-bytes.json', {'parent_candidate_sha': v.HEAD, 'files': files,
    'note': 'Prospective OIDs were calculated read-only; no Git index update or object write'})

whitespace = []
for name, argv in [('worktree-ordinary', ['diff', '--check']),
                   ('worktree-cr-at-eol', ['-c', 'core.whitespace=cr-at-eol', 'diff', '--check']),
                   ('cached-ordinary', ['diff', '--cached', '--check']),
                   ('cached-cr-at-eol', ['-c', 'core.whitespace=cr-at-eol', 'diff', '--cached', '--check'])]:
    p = subprocess.run(['git', *argv], cwd=ROOT, env=v.ENV, capture_output=True)
    assert p.returncode == 0 and not p.stdout and not p.stderr
    whitespace.append({'name': name, 'argv': ['git', *argv], 'exit_code': p.returncode,
                       'stdout_base64': base64.b64encode(p.stdout).decode(),
                       'stderr_base64': base64.b64encode(p.stderr).decode(), 'classification': 'PASS'})
save(E / 'whitespace.json', {'checks': whitespace, 'scope': 'Diff against published candidate; original151-file publication diagnostics are historical and unchanged'})

helpers = {}
for name in ['i02_handoff_verify.py', 'i02_handoff_full_content.py', 'i02_handoff_runtime_smoke.py', 'i02_handoff_finalize.py']:
    raw = (ROOT / 'var' / name).read_bytes()
    helpers['var/' + name] = {'sha256': sha(raw), 'source_utf8': raw.decode()}
save(E / 'raw-command-receipts.json', {'format': 'Exact raw bytes encoded in base64, with individual SHA256; no EOL normalization',
    'receipts': raw_receipts, 'reproduction_helper_sources': helpers})
# Delete only this run's own decoded log copies after lossless retention. Never touch candidate history.
for label in raw_receipts:
    for suffix in ('.stdout.log', '.stderr.log'):
        path = E / (label + suffix)

"""Finish current evidence only; keep original captured stdout/stderr lossless."""
import base64
from hashlib import sha256
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / 'var'))
import i02_handoff_verify as v
E = v.E

def save(path, data):
    path.write_bytes((json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n').encode('utf-8'))

def sha(raw):
    return sha256(raw).hexdigest()

raw_path = E / 'raw-command-receipts.json'
raw_record = json.loads(raw_path.read_bytes())
source = Path(__file__).read_bytes()
raw_record['reproduction_helper_sources']['var/i02_handoff_seal.py'] = {'sha256': sha(source), 'source_utf8': source.decode()}
save(raw_path, raw_record)
verification_path = E / 'verification.json'
verification = json.loads(verification_path.read_bytes())
for command in verification['commands']:
    command['label'] = command.get('raw_receipt_key', command['label'])
save(verification_path, verification)
# Current metadata is UTF-8/LF; raw command bytes stay unchanged inside base64.
# The protected candidate/history outside this newly created directory is untouched.
for path in E.iterdir():
    if path.is_file() and path.suffix in {'.json', '.md'}:
        raw = path.read_bytes()
        normalized = raw.replace(b'\r\n', b'\n')
        if path.suffix == '.json':
            record = json.loads(normalized)
            if 'label' in record:
                record['label'] = path.stem
                normalized = (json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n').encode()
            assert json.loads(raw) == json.loads(normalized) or 'label' in record
        path.write_bytes(normalized)

checks = []
env = {**os.environ, 'GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS': '0'}
def check(path):
    proc = subprocess.run(['git', 'diff', '--no-index', '--check', '--', '/dev/null', str(path)],
        cwd=ROOT, env=env, capture_output=True)
    assert proc.returncode == 1 and not proc.stdout and not proc.stderr, (path.name, proc.returncode, proc.stderr)
    return {'path': path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(), 'exit_code': 1, 'stdout_base64': '', 'stderr_base64': '',
            'meaning': 'Expected new-file difference from null, no whitespace diagnostics; not PASS/0'}
for path in sorted(E.iterdir()):
    if path.is_file() and path.name != 'evidence-inventory.json':
        checks.append(check(path))
save(E / 'new-records-whitespace.json', {'checks': checks, 'diagnostics': 0,
    'new_metadata_encoding': 'UTF-8 LF; captured raw stdout/stderr retained as exact base64 bytes',
    'exit_code_interpretation': 'no-index difference from null returns1; whitespace errors return2 with diagnostics'})
baseline = json.loads((E / 'source-baseline.json').read_bytes())
for path, pin in baseline['protected_working_hashes'].items():
    assert sha((ROOT / path).read_bytes()) == pin, path
assert v.git('rev-parse', 'HEAD').decode().strip() == v.HEAD
idx = Path(v.git('rev-parse', '--git-path', 'index').decode().strip())
assert sha(idx.read_bytes()) == baseline['raw_index_sha256']
assert set(v.git('diff', '--name-only').decode().splitlines()) == v.ALLOWED
assert not v.git('diff', '--cached', '--name-only')
assert all(p.startswith(E.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix() + '/') for p in v.git('ls-files', '--others', '--exclude-standard').decode().splitlines())
for label, receipt in raw_record['receipts'].items():
    for key in list(receipt):
        if key.endswith('_base64'):
            assert sha(base64.b64decode(receipt[key])) == receipt[key.replace('_base64', '_sha256')]
save(E / 'evidence-inventory.json', {'self_excluded': 'evidence-inventory.json',
    'files': [{'path': p.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(), 'bytes': p.stat().st_size, 'sha256': sha(p.read_bytes())}
              for p in sorted(E.iterdir()) if p.is_file() and p.name != 'evidence-inventory.json']})
final_checks = [check(p) for p in sorted(E.iterdir()) if p.is_file()]
print(json.dumps({'recommendation': verification['recommendation'], 'tests': verification['tests'],
    'protected_files_unchanged': len(baseline['protected_working_hashes']), 'index_sha256': sha(idx.read_bytes()),
    'tracked_changed': sorted(v.ALLOWED), 'new_records': len(final_checks), 'new_record_whitespace_diagnostics': 0,
    'new_record_no_index_exit_codes': sorted({c['exit_code'] for c in final_checks}),
    'raw_receipts_hash_verified': True, 'evidence': str(E)}, indent=2))
